verses.en: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah began Hoshea the son of Elah to reign in Samaria over Israel nine years.
verses.pt: No ano duodécimo de Acaz, rei de Judá, começou a reinar Oséias, filho de Elá, e reinou sobre Israel, em Samária nove anos.
verses.en_web: In the twelfth year of Ahaz king of Judah, Hoshea the son of Elah began to reign in Samaria over Israel for nine years.
verses.en_bbe: In the twelfth year of Ahaz, king of Judah, Hoshea, the son of Elah, became king over Israel in Samaria, ruling for nine years.

verses.en: And he did that which was evil in the sight of the LORD, but not as the kings of Israel that were before him.
verses.pt: E fez o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, contudo não como os reis de Israel que foram antes dele.
verses.en_web: He did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, yet not as the kings of Israel who were before him.
verses.en_bbe: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, though not like the kings of Israel before him.

verses.en: Against him came up Shalmaneser king of Assyria; and Hoshea became his servant, and gave him presents.
verses.pt: Contra ele subiu Salmanasar, rei da Assiria; e Oséias ficou sendo servo dele e lhe pagava tributos.
verses.en_web: Shalmaneser king of Assyria came up against him, and Hoshea became his servant, and brought him tribute.
verses.en_bbe: Against him came up Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, and Hoshea became his servant and sent him offerings.

verses.en: And the king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea: for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and brought no present to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: therefore the king of Assyria shut him up, and bound him in prison.
verses.pt: O rei da Assíria , porém, achou em Oséias conspiração; porque ele enviara mensageiros a Sô, rei do Egito, e não pagava, como dantes, os tributos anuais ao rei da Assíria; então este o encerrou e o pôs em grilhões numa prisão.
verses.en_web: The king of Assyria found conspiracy in Hoshea; for he had sent messengers to So king of Egypt, and offered no tribute to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year. Therefore the king of Assyria seized him, and bound him in prison.
verses.en_bbe: But Hoshea's broken faith became clear to the king of Assyria because he had sent representatives to So, king of Egypt, and did not send his offering to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: so the king of Assyria had him shut up in prison and put in chains.

verses.en: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, and went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.pt: E o rei da Assíria subiu por toda a terra, e chegando a Samária sitiou-a por três anos.
verses.en_web: Then the king of Assyria came up throughout all the land, went up to Samaria, and besieged it three years.
verses.en_bbe: Then the king of Assyria went through all the land and came up to Samaria, shutting it in with his forces for three years.

verses.en: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away into Assyria, and placed them in Halah and in Habor by the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.pt: No ano nono de Oséias, o rei da Assíria tomou Samária, e levou Israel cativo para a Assíria; e fê-los habitar em Hala, e junto a Habor, o rio de Gozã, e nas cidades dos medos.
verses.en_web: In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in Halah, and on the Habor, the river of Gozan, and in the cities of the Medes.
verses.en_bbe: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria took Samaria, and took Israel away to Assyria, placing them in Halah and in Habor on the river Gozan, and in the towns of the Medes.

verses.en: For so it was, that the children of Israel had sinned against the LORD their God, which had brought them up out of the land of Egypt, from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.pt: Assim sucedeu, porque os filhos de Israel tinham pecado contra o Senhor seu Deus que os fizera subir da terra do Egito, de debaixo da mãe de Faraó, rei do Egito, e porque haviam temido a outros deuses,
verses.en_web: It was so because the children of Israel had sinned against Yahweh their God, who brought them up out of the land of Egypt from under the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and had feared other gods,
verses.en_bbe: And the wrath of the Lord came on Israel because they had done evil against the Lord their God, who took them out of the land of Egypt from under the yoke of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and had become worshippers of other gods,

verses.en: And walked in the statutes of the heathen, whom the LORD cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they had made.
verses.pt: e andado segundo os costumes das nações que o Senhor lançara fora de diante dos filhos de Israel, e segundo os que os reis de Israel introduziram.
verses.en_web: and walked in the statutes of the nations whom Yahweh cast out from before the children of Israel, and of the kings of Israel, which they made.
verses.en_bbe: Living by the rules of the nations whom the Lord had sent out from before the children of Israel.

verses.en: And the children of Israel did secretly those things that were not right against the LORD their God, and they built them high places in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fenced city.
verses.pt: Também os filhos de Israel fizeram secretamente contra o Senhor seu Deus coisas que não eram retas. Edificaram para si altos em todas as suas cidades, desde a torre das atalaias até a cidade fortificada;
verses.en_web: The children of Israel secretly did things that were not right against Yahweh their God; and they built high places for themselves in all their cities, from the tower of the watchmen to the fortified city;
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel did secretly against the Lord their God things which were not right, building high places for themselves in all their towns, from the tower of the watchmen to the walled town.

verses.en: And they set them up images and groves in every high hill, and under every green tree:
verses.pt: Levantaram para si colunas e aserins em todos os altos outeiros, e debaixo de todas as árvores frondosas;
verses.en_web: and they set up for themselves pillars and Asherah poles on every high hill, and under every green tree;
verses.en_bbe: They put up pillars of stone and wood on every high hill and under every green tree:

verses.en: And there they burnt incense in all the high places, as did the heathen whom the LORD carried away before them; and wrought wicked things to provoke the LORD to anger:
verses.pt: queimaram incenso em todos os altos, como as nações que o Senhor expulsara de diante deles; cometeram ações iníquas, provocando à ira o Senhor,
verses.en_web: and there they burned incense in all the high places, as the nations whom Yahweh carried away before them did; and they did wicked things to provoke Yahweh to anger;
verses.en_bbe: Burning their offerings in all the high places, as those nations did whom the Lord sent away from before them; they did evil things, moving the Lord to wrath;

verses.en: For they served idols, whereof the LORD had said unto them, Ye shall not do this thing.
verses.pt: e serviram os ídolos, dos quais o Senhor lhes dissera: Não fareis isso.
verses.en_web: and they served idols, of which Yahweh had said to them, “You shall not do this thing.”
verses.en_bbe: And they made themselves servants of disgusting things, though the Lord had said, You are not to do this.

verses.en: Yet the LORD testified against Israel, and against Judah, by all the prophets, and by all the seers, saying, Turn ye from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.
verses.pt: Todavia o Senhor advertiu a Israel e a Judá pelo ministério de todos os profetas e de todos os videntes, dizendo: Voltai de vossos maus caminhos, e guardai os meus mandamentos e os meus estatutos, conforme toda a lei que ordenei a vossos pais e que vos enviei pelo ministério de meus servos, os profetas.
verses.en_web: Yet Yahweh testified to Israel, and to Judah, by every prophet, and every seer, saying, “Turn from your evil ways, and keep my commandments and my statutes, according to all the law which I commanded your fathers, and which I sent to you by my servants the prophets.”
verses.en_bbe: And he gave witness to Israel and Judah, by every prophet and seer, saying, Come back from your evil ways, and do my orders and keep my rules, and be guided by the law which I gave to your fathers and sent to you by my servants the prophets.

verses.en: Notwithstanding they would not hear, but hardened their necks, like to the neck of their fathers, that did not believe in the LORD their God.
verses.pt: Eles porém, não deram ouvidos; antes endureceram a sua cerviz, como fizeram seus pais, que não creram no Senhor seu Deus;
verses.en_web: Notwithstanding, they would not listen, but hardened their neck, like the neck of their fathers, who didn’t believe in Yahweh their God.
verses.en_bbe: And they did not give ear, but became stiff-necked, like their fathers who had no faith in the Lord their God.

verses.en: And they rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified against them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and went after the heathen that were round about them, concerning whom the LORD had charged them, that they should not do like them.
verses.pt: rejeitaram os seus estatutos, e o seu pacto, que fizera com os pais deles, como também as advertências que lhes fizera; seguiram a vaidade e tornaram-se vãos, como também seguiram as nações que estavam ao redor deles, a respeito das quais o Senhor lhes tinha ordenado que não as imitassem.
verses.en_web: They rejected his statutes, and his covenant that he made with their fathers, and his testimonies which he testified to them; and they followed vanity, and became vain, and followed the nations that were around them, concerning whom Yahweh had commanded them that they should not do like them.
verses.en_bbe: And they went against his rules, and the agreement which he made with their fathers, and his laws which he gave them; they gave themselves up to things without sense or value, and became foolish like the nations round them, of whom the Lord had said, Do not as they do.

verses.en: And they left all the commandments of the LORD their God, and made them molten images, even two calves, and made a grove, and worshipped all the host of heaven, and served Baal.
verses.pt: E, deixando todos os mandamentos do Senhor seu Deus, fizeram para si dois bezerros de fundição, e ainda uma Asera; adoraram todo o exército do céu, e serviram a Baal.
verses.en_web: They abandoned all the commandments of Yahweh their God, and made molten images for themselves, even two calves, and made an Asherah, and worshiped all the army of the sky, and served Baal.
verses.en_bbe: And turning their backs on all the orders which the Lord had given them, they made for themselves images of metal, and the image of Asherah, worshipping all the stars of heaven and becoming servants to Baal.

verses.en: And they caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, and used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.pt: Fizeram passar pelo fogo seus filhos, suas filhas, e deram- se a adivinhações e encantamentos; e venderam-se para fazer o que era mau aos olhos do Senhor, provocando-o à ira.
verses.en_web: They caused their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire, used divination and enchantments, and sold themselves to do that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger.
verses.en_bbe: And they made their sons and their daughters go through the fire, and they made use of secret arts and unnatural powers, and gave themselves up to doing evil in the eyes of the Lord, till he was moved to wrath.

verses.en: Therefore the LORD was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor muito se indignou contra Israel, e os tirou de diante da sua face; não ficou senão somente a tribo de Judá.
verses.en_web: Therefore Yahweh was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight. There was none left but the tribe of Judah only.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord was very angry with Israel, and his face was turned away from them: only the tribe of Judah kept its place.

verses.en: Also Judah kept not the commandments of the LORD their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.pt: Nem mesmo Judá havia guardado os mandamentos do Senhor seu Deus; antes andou nos costumes que Israel introduzira.
verses.en_web: Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
verses.en_bbe: (But even Judah did not keep the orders of the Lord their God, but were guided by the rules which Israel had made.

verses.en: And the LORD rejected all the seed of Israel, and afflicted them, and delivered them into the hand of spoilers, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.pt: Pelo que o Senhor rejeitou toda a linhagem de Israel, e os oprimiu, entregando-os nas mãos dos despojadores, até que os expulsou da sua presença.
verses.en_web: Yahweh rejected all the offspring of Israel, afflicted them, and delivered them into the hands of raiders, until he had cast them out of his sight.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord would have nothing to do with all the offspring of Israel, and sent trouble on them, and gave them up into the hands of their attackers, till he had sent them away from before his face.)

verses.en: For he rent Israel from the house of David; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king: and Jeroboam drave Israel from following the LORD, and made them sin a great sin.
verses.pt: Pois rasgara Israel da casa de Davi; e eles fizeram rei a Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, o qual apartou Israel de seguir o Senhor, e os fez cometer um grande pecado.
verses.en_web: For he tore Israel from David’s house; and they made Jeroboam the son of Nebat king; and Jeroboam drove Israel from following Yahweh, and made them sin a great sin.
verses.en_bbe: For Israel was broken off from the family of David, and they made Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, king, who, driving them away from the laws of the Lord, made them do a great sin.

verses.en: For the children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they departed not from them;
verses.pt: Assim andaram os filhos de Israel em todos os pecados que Jeroboão tinha cometido; nunca se apartaram deles;
verses.en_web: The children of Israel walked in all the sins of Jeroboam which he did; they didn’t depart from them
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Israel went on with all the sins which Jeroboam did; they did not keep themselves from them;

verses.en: Until the LORD removed Israel out of his sight, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So was Israel carried away out of their own land to Assyria unto this day.
verses.pt: até que o Senhor tirou Israel da sua presença, como falara por intermédio de todos os seus servos os profetas. Assim foi Israel transportado da sua terra para a Assíria, onde está até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: until Yahweh removed Israel out of his sight, as he said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was carried away out of their own land to Assyria to this day.
verses.en_bbe: Till the Lord put Israel away from before his face, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was taken away from their land to Assyria, to this day.

verses.en: And the king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, and from Cuthah, and from Ava, and from Hamath, and from Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel: and they possessed Samaria, and dwelt in the cities thereof.
verses.pt: Depois o rei da Assíria trouxe gente de Babilônia, de Cuta, de Ava, de Hamate e de Sefarvaim, e a fez habitar nas cidades de Samária em lugar dos filhos de Israel; e eles tomaram Samária em herança, e habitaram nas suas cidades.
verses.en_web: The king of Assyria brought men from Babylon, from Cuthah, from Avva, and from Hamath and Sepharvaim, and placed them in the cities of Samaria instead of the children of Israel; and they possessed Samaria, and lived in its cities.
verses.en_bbe: Then the king of Assyria took men from Babylon and from Cuthah and Avva and Hamath and Sepharvaim, and put them in the towns of Samaria in place of the children of Israel; so they got Samaria for their heritage, living in its towns.

verses.en: And so it was at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they feared not the LORD: therefore the LORD sent lions among them, which slew some of them.
verses.pt: E sucedeu que, no princípio da sua habitação ali, não temeram ao Senhor; e o Senhor mandou entre eles leões, que mataram alguns deles.
verses.en_web: So it was, at the beginning of their dwelling there, that they didn’t fear Yahweh. Therefore Yahweh sent lions among them, which killed some of them.
verses.en_bbe: Now when first they were living there they did not give worship to the Lord. So the Lord sent lions among them, causing the death of some of them.

verses.en: Wherefore they spake to the king of Assyria, saying, The nations which thou hast removed, and placed in the cities of Samaria, know not the manner of the God of the land: therefore he hath sent lions among them, and, behold, they slay them, because they know not the manner of the God of the land.
verses.pt: Pelo que foi dito ao rei da Assíria: A gente que transportaste, e fizeste habitar nas cidades de Samária, não conhece a lei do deus da terra; por isso ele tem enviado entre ela leões que a matam, porquanto não conhece a lei do deus da terra.
verses.en_web: Therefore they spoke to the king of Assyria, saying, “The nations which you have carried away and placed in the cities of Samaria don’t know the law of the god of the land. Therefore he has sent lions among them, and behold, they kill them, because they don’t know the law of the god of the land.”
verses.en_bbe: So they said to the king of Assyria, The nations whom you have taken as prisoners and put in the towns of Samaria, have no knowledge of the way of the god of the land: so he has sent lions among them, causing their death, because they have no knowledge of his way.

verses.en: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, Carry thither one of the priests whom ye brought from thence; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the manner of the God of the land.
verses.pt: Então o rei da Assíria mandou dizer: Levai ali um dos sacerdotes que transportastes de lá para que vá e habite ali, e lhes ensine a lei do deus da terra.
verses.en_web: Then the king of Assyria commanded, saying, “Carry there one of the priests whom you brought from there; and let them go and dwell there, and let him teach them the law of the god of the land.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the king of Assyria gave orders, saying, Send there one of the priests whom you took away, and let him be living there and teaching the people the way of the god of the land.

verses.en: Then one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and dwelt in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear the LORD.
verses.pt: Veio, pois, um dos sacerdotes que eles tinham transportado de Samária, e habitou em Betel, e lhes ensinou como deviam temer ao Senhor.
verses.en_web: So one of the priests whom they had carried away from Samaria came and lived in Bethel, and taught them how they should fear Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: So one of the priests whom they had taken away as a prisoner from Samaria came back, and, living in Beth-el, became their teacher in the worship of the Lord.

verses.en: Howbeit every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities wherein they dwelt.
verses.pt: Todavia as nações faziam cada uma o seu próprio deus, e os punham nas casas dos altos que os samaritanos tinham feito, cada nação nas cidades que habitava.
verses.en_web: However every nation made gods of their own, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in their cities in which they lived.
verses.en_bbe: And every nation made gods for themselves, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in the towns where they were living.

verses.en: And the men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.pt: Os de Babilônia fizeram e Sucote-Benote; os de Cuta fizeram Nergal; os de Hamate fizeram Asima;
verses.en_web: The men of Babylon made Succoth Benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
verses.en_bbe: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,

verses.en: And the Avites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.pt: os aveus fizeram Nibaz e Tartaque: e os sefarvitas queimavam seus filhos no fogo e a adrameleque e a Anameleque, deuses de Sefarvaim.
verses.en_web: and the Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak; and the Sepharvites burned their children in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
verses.en_bbe: The Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites gave their children to be burned in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.

verses.en: So they feared the LORD, and made unto themselves of the lowest of them priests of the high places, which sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.pt: Temiam também ao Senhor, e dentre o povo fizeram para si sacerdotes dos lugares altos, os quais exerciam o ministério nas casas dos lugares altos.
verses.en_web: So they feared Yahweh, and also made from among themselves priests of the high places for themselves, who sacrificed for them in the houses of the high places.
verses.en_bbe: So they went on worshipping the Lord, and made for themselves, from among all the people, priests for the high places, to make offerings for them in the houses of the high places.

verses.en: They feared the LORD, and served their own gods, after the manner of the nations whom they carried away from thence.
verses.pt: Assim temiam ao Senhor, mas também serviam a seus próprios deuses, segundo o costume das nações do meio das quais tinham sido transportados.
verses.en_web: They feared Yahweh, and also served their own gods, after the ways of the nations from among whom they had been carried away.
verses.en_bbe: They gave worship to the Lord, but they gave honour to their gods like the nations did from whom they had been taken as prisoners.

verses.en: Unto this day they do after the former manners: they fear not the LORD, neither do they after their statutes, or after their ordinances, or after the law and commandment which the LORD commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
verses.pt: Até o dia de hoje fazem segundo os antigos costumes: não temem ao Senhor; nem fazem segundo os seus estatutos, nem segundo as suas ordenanças; nem tampouco segundo a lei, nem segundo o mandamento que o Senhor ordenou aos filhos de Jacó, a quem deu o nome de Israel,
verses.en_web: To this day they do what they did before. They don’t fear Yahweh, and they do not follow the statutes, or the ordinances, or the law, or the commandment which Yahweh commanded the children of Jacob, whom he named Israel;
verses.en_bbe: So to this day they go on in their old ways, not worshipping the Lord or keeping his orders or his ways or the law and the rule which the Lord gave to the children of Jacob, to whom he gave the name Israel;

verses.en: With whom the LORD had made a covenant, and charged them saying, Ye shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them:
verses.pt: com os quais o Senhor tinha feito um pacto, e lhes ordenara, dizendo: Não temereis outros deuses, nem vos inclinareis diante deles, nem os servireis, nem lhes oferecereis sacrificios;
verses.en_web: with whom Yahweh had made a covenant, and commanded them, saying, “You shall not fear other gods, nor bow yourselves to them, nor serve them, nor sacrifice to them;
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord made an agreement with them and gave them orders, saying, You are to have no other gods; you are not to give worship to them or be their servants or make them offerings:

verses.en: But the LORD, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and a stretched out arm, him shall ye fear, and him shall ye worship, and to him shall ye do sacrifice.
verses.pt: mas sim ao Senhor, que vos fez subir da terra do Egito com grande poder e com braço estendido, a ele temereis, a ele vos inclinareis, e a ele oferecereis sacrifícios.
verses.en_web: but you shall fear Yahweh, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt with great power and with an outstretched arm, and you shall bow yourselves to him, and you shall sacrifice to him.
verses.en_bbe: But the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt with his great power and his outstretched arm, he is your God, to whom you are to give worship and make offerings:

verses.en: And the statutes, and the ordinances, and the law, and the commandment, which he wrote for you, ye shall observe to do for evermore; and ye shall not fear other gods.
verses.pt: Quanto aos estatutos, às ordenanças, à lei, e ao mandamento, que para vós escreveu, a esses tereis cuidado de observar todos os dias; e não temereis outros deuses;
verses.en_web: The statutes and the ordinances, and the law and the commandment, which he wrote for you, you shall observe to do forever more. You shall not fear other gods.
verses.en_bbe: And the rules and the orders and the law which he put in writing for you, you are to keep and do for ever; you are to have no other gods.

verses.en: And the covenant that I have made with you ye shall not forget; neither shall ye fear other gods.
verses.pt: e do pacto que fiz convosco não vos esquecereis. Não temereis outros deuses,
verses.en_web: You shall not forget the covenant that I have made with you. You shall not fear other gods.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to keep in memory the agreement which I have made with you; and you are to have no other gods.

verses.en: But the LORD your God ye shall fear; and he shall deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.
verses.pt: mas ao Senhor vosso Deus temereis, e ele vos livrará das mãos de todos os vossos inimigos.
verses.en_web: But you shall fear Yahweh your God, and he will deliver you out of the hand of all your enemies.”
verses.en_bbe: And you are to give worship to the Lord your God; for it is he who will give you salvation from the hands of all who are against you.

verses.en: Howbeit they did not hearken, but they did after their former manner.
verses.pt: Contudo eles não ouviram; antes fizeram segundo o seu antigo costume.
verses.en_web: However they did not listen, but they did what they did before.
verses.en_bbe: But they gave no attention, but went on in their old way.

verses.en: So these nations feared the LORD, and served their graven images, both their children, and their children’s children: as did their fathers, so do they unto this day.
verses.pt: Assim estas nações temiam ao Senhor, mas serviam também as suas imagens esculpidas; também seus filhos, e os filhos de seus filhos fazem até o dia de hoje como fizeram seus pais.
verses.en_web: So these nations feared Yahweh, and also served their engraved images. Their children likewise, and their children’s children, as their fathers did, so they do to this day.
verses.en_bbe: So these nations, worshipping the Lord, still were servants to the images they had made; their children and their children's children did the same; as their fathers did, so do they, to this day.
